deviations.claim_in_article: “Oil prices did not fall across the whole market after the plan was withdrawn.”
deviations.issue: The article makes a claim about the whole oil market, while the Ledger reports the post-announcement movement specifically for Brent futures. The broader market-wide claim is not established by that observation.
deviations.explanation: The claim extends the observed Brent-futures movement to the whole oil market, asserting a concrete market-wide fact not established by the Ledger; this changes scope and adds an unsupported claim.
deviations.qualifier_text: “briefly lost some of their gains” and “soon returned to a high level”
